operator_setup: User confirmed the cube rested loose on the table and was not held by hand or attached to a fixture.
useful_for: Closing preload and unloading during lift of an unrestrained cube.
interpretation: The approximately 24 N closing preload unloaded to near zero axial load, with less than 1 N opposing load afterward. This is consistent with lifting the loose cube, not pulling it out of the grasp.
limitation: No fixed restraint; no measured pull-out capacity. The approximately 24.7 N closed-baseline change is not holding force.
